reviewKind: three separate AI technical reviewer contexts; no human approval
locationPolicy: symbol locations resolve against baseline and fix commits; regression file is tests/Diorthosis.Tests/PeerReviewRegressionTests.cs except explicit Python path

findings.rootCause: An NFC-equivalent prefix with different UTF-16 length shifts later candidate offsets.
findings.reproduction: The café recieved it. → The cafe\u0301 received it.
findings.actualBeforeFix: Evaluator threw on shifted candidate substring.
findings.correction: Track actual candidate starts through canonical diff merges.

findings.rootCause: One canonical edit can touch independent annotations, but was scored twice independently.
findings.reproduction: He recieve it. → He received it?; two annotations cover ie→ei and inserted d.
findings.expected: Credit both repairs, retain unrelated punctuation as unresolved.
findings.correction: Union annotation/dependency components touched by a shared edit.

findings.rootCause: Unknown full-passage reference product was put in failure denominator.
findings.reproduction: Nine independent annotations with two alternatives each exceed 256 reference combinations.
findings.correction: Exclude unknown judgments from success denominator; expose coverage.

findings.rootCause: Position-based annotation IDs were reusable after annotation reorder.
findings.reproduction: She have recieved it. → She has receive it.; reverse grammar/spelling annotations.
findings.expected: Old review cannot attach to a different proposal.
findings.actualBeforeFix: annotation:0 transferred a positive grammar review to a spelling miss.
findings.correction: Bind IDs to source, language, sorted annotation contract, group and edits.

findings.rootCause: Insertion endpoints were excluded from protected-span intersection.
findings.reproduction: The applicant is eligible. → The applicant is ineligible.; protect eligible.

findings.rootCause: Global punctuation/word inventories lose proposition association and multiplicity.
findings.reproduction: Is the file ready? The task is done. Wait. → Is the file ready. The task is done? Wait.; duplicate-word statement omission.
findings.expected: Reject question movement and complete statement deletion.
findings.actualBeforeFix: Accepted changed speech acts / omitted statement.
findings.correction: Compare ordered speech acts and detect full-statement deletion with lost token multiplicity.

findings.rootCause: Combining marks, single quotation marks, and dates without years were missing from protection.
findings.expected: No deliverable edits to protected content.
findings.correction: Include Unicode marks, unambiguous single quotes and yearless dates.

findings.rootCause: Demonstrated no/time/agent/relation substitutions were not covered.
findings.reproduction: There is no risk. → There is risk.; yesterday→tomorrow; She gave him→He gave her; after→before.
findings.correction: Add bounded negation, temporal/relational and ordered personal anchors.

findings.rootCause: An already parsed literal candidate was passed through chat-wrapper extraction.
findings.expected: Extracted, diffed and delivered text agree literally.
findings.actualBeforeFix: Markup stripped while extracted field reported literal markup.
findings.correction: Separate literal-candidate validation from wrapper extraction.

findings.rootCause: JsonElement.GetString throws InvalidOperationException on escaped lone surrogate.
findings.reproduction: Structured edit contains escaped lone high surrogate.

findings.rootCause: Compare output accepted an existing input file.
findings.correction: Require distinct new outputs and exclusive CreateNew writes.

findings.rootCause: Original report identity was copied without dataset/trace binding.
findings.reproduction: Replay with wrong dataset hash/model identity/case count.
findings.expected: Reject mismatch; label unbound legacy identities.
findings.actualBeforeFix: Replayed metrics carried unrelated model/resource claims.
findings.correction: Verify dataset/count and optional trace hash; retain original claims nested; hash emitted trace.

findings.rootCause: Pinned HEAD alone does not exclude dirty cached source.
findings.reproduction: Tracked mutation survives git checkout pinned SHA.
findings.actualBeforeFix: Modified cached source could be compiled at pinned HEAD.
findings.correction: Fresh private source/build roots and origin/HEAD/clean verifier.

findings.rootCause: English I was treated as a name only in interior position.
findings.reproduction: Tomorrow I will the package send. → I will send the package tomorrow.
findings.expected: Allow safe word movement with I preserved.
findings.correction: Recognize I consistently; retain personal-anchor protection.
